With countless options for entertainment, leisure, and sightseeing, it's essential to find the perfect accommodation. Addressing this need, Asia King Travel presents a comprehensive guide to the best hotels in Hanoi, ensuring a memorable stay for tourists. In this guide, we will mainly discuss the areas with the highest concentration of foreign tourists: Hoan Kiem, Tay Ho, and Ba Dinh. Hotels to stay in Hoan Kiem Hoan Kiem District is situated in the heart of the capital. Because of its strategic location, the Hoan Kiem District has served as a link between districts, forming a strong tourism block, and attracting a large number of foreigners from many nations to work and reside in the Hoan Kiem District. Meliá Hanoi Hotel Address: 44 Ly Thuong Kiet, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Room prices: ~$197/night Part of the renowned Meliá Hotel & Resorts hotel chain, Meliá Hanoi rises 22 floors in Hanoi's Old Quarter , offering 306 rooms in various categories. As a guest of this prestigious 5-star hotel, you will enjoy a special appreciation for the quality of its rooms and service. Melia Hanoi Hotel Located only about 1.9 km from Hanoi Old Quarter, Meliá Hanoi is close to many other tourist attractions. It is 650 meters away from Hoan Kiem Lake and Thang Long Water Puppet Theater . This hotel features a casino, outdoor swimming pool, fitness center and spa. It also offers free parking. Each of its rooms is modern and equipped with a flat-screen cable TV, safety deposit box, and tea/coffee-making devices, along with 24/7 service. Au Coeur d'Hanoi Boutique Hotel Address: 62 Hang Be, Ly Thai To, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Room prices: 30.5/night If you're looking for a cheap hotel in Hanoi's Old Quarter, Au Coeur d'Hanoi Boutique is an excellent option. The facility provides a choice of rooms ranging from 25 to 40 square meters, each completely furnished with furniture such as a TV, refrigerator, and safe, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay. Au Coeur d'Hanoi Boutique Hotel The hotel also offers a separate restaurant area that specializes in European and Vietnamese food. Thanks to its convenient position on Hang Be Street, visitors can quickly access numerous well-known sights such as Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Opera House , Dong Xuan Market, and others. Oriental Jade Hotel in Hanoi Address: 92 - 94 Hang Trong, Hang Trong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi Room prices: $126/night Oriental Jade Hotel Hanoi has 120 luxury rooms and suites with panoramic views of Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Old Quarter, and Hanoi Cathedral. This hotel's location on Hang Trong Street makes it easy to walk about Hanoi's Old Town. Oriental Jade Hotel Hanoi The fitness facility, which is outfitted with the latest equipment, will satisfy exercise enthusiasts, and the outdoor swimming pool on the 12th floor offers breathtaking views. Oriental Jade caters to culinary enthusiasts with a diverse menu of Vietnamese delicacies suitable for all palates, including foreign tourists, ensuring taste enjoyment. You may like: 10 Attractions in Hanoi Hotels to stay in Tay Ho In recent years, Tay Ho district has become densely populated due to a surge in immigrants from other districts and provinces, due to it offering modern amenities like luxury apartments, Western restaurants, gyms, medical facilities, shops, international schools, and supermarkets. Tay Ho's serene ambiance and convenience have made it the district with the largest foreign community in Hanoi, especially around the West Lake coastal area. InterContinental Hanoi Westlake Address: 05 Tu Hoa Street, Tay Ho District, Hanoi Room prices: ~$161/night The InterContinental Hanoi Westlake is the most luxurious resort in the West Lake region, distinguished by its extraordinary architectural and geographic coordinates. Its design, inspired by the post-unification Vietnamese setting, seamlessly incorporates the characteristic patterns of bronze drums to represent the national spirit and conserve Vietnamese cultural heritage. InterContinental Hanoi Westlake Hotel Aside from its remarkable beauty, the InterContinental Hanoi Westlake is close to Hanoi's must-see tourist attractions, including the Thang Long Puppet Theater and the Hanoi Old Quarter. This hotel certainly provides beautiful views of West Lake, making it a worthy destination for visitors looking for an unforgettable experience in Hanoi. Diamond Westlake Suites Address: 96 Ngoc Van, Quang An, Tay Ho, Hanoi Room prices: ~$85/night The Diamond Westlake Suites, a five-star resort situated by the lakeside, is the next location. This hotel's prime location along a busy transportation route makes it simple to go to famous locations like Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and the Opera House, which are both about ten minutes away by car. Diamond Westlake Suites Hotel Known for being the magnificent hotel in Hanoi with 360-degree views of the West Lake, Diamond Westlake Suites is distinguished by its striking architecture, contemporary decor, and extensive amenities that are intended to please every visitor. For those looking for a convenient and luxurious experience in the enchanting city of Hanoi, this is the perfect spot. Elegant Suites Westlake Serviced Residences Address: 10B Dang Thai Mai, Tay Ho District, Hanoi, Vietnam Room prices: ~$88/night Westlake Elegant Serviced Residences is a five-star property with tasteful European architecture. This building showcases the serene and lyrical beauty of West Lake's shoreline by fusing modern and classical architecture in a novel way. Elegant Suites Westlake Serviced Residences Hotel There are 135 rooms in the design, each with its own nuance and style and roomy, contemporary furnishings to suit different demands. A children's playground, a swimming pool, views of West Lake from the balconies of each room, and much more are also available. A stay at this hotel will provide you with outstanding service and an experience that you will never forget. Hotels to stay in Ba Dinh Lakeside House Address: No.99, 135 Doi Can, Ba Dinh, Hanoi, Vietnam Room prices: ~$19/night Lakeside House, which is located near the banks of Huu Tiep Lake, is distinguished by its distinct charm and serene ambiance. Lakeside House provides the ideal ratio of luxury to natural scenery. Lakeside House Hotel To meet your expectations, the facility provides first-rate amenities, tastefully furnished rooms, and dedicated service. Every time spent at Lakeside House is intended to create enduring memories, whether you're lounging by the pool, seeing the neighborhood, or indulging in exquisite dining. Michi house Address: 99 Le Hong Phong, Dien Bien, Ba Dinh, Hanoi Room prices: ~$38/night The magnificent MICHI House, located just 6km away from the One Pillar Pagoda , provides guests with an amazing haven. With its quaint design and prime position across from the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the hotel offers an ideal starting point for discovering the city's cultural gems. MICHI House Hotel Famous locations close to MICHI House include the Vietnam Fine Arts Museum, the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, and the esteemed Temple of Literature . Each of these locations provides an enlightening look into Vietnamese history and culture. Conclusion In conclusion, these are some recommendations for places to stay when you’re visiting Hanoi. Make your choice and pamper yourself with the captivating beauty of this fascinating city.
